notes: Night-watch hardening - car 3 of the autonomous-operations design: web3 approvals, heartbeat alerts, mission hooks, quiet hours and mission constraints, all inside the existing red lines. Approval interlock: a subtask that reaches a web3 order now suspends into paused_approve while sibling subtasks keep advancing; the approval gate itself is untouched - prepare -> human approval -> execute, bearer checks and the same-day ledger review all behave exactly as before, and the drill in the unit suite proves execute still refuses without approval. Observation runs each tick: approved plans resume the subtask and the mission flips back to running on its own (the console approves in the existing Web3 panel and does nothing else), rejected or expired plans degrade the subtask with a gap and a report. Heartbeat: the watchdog reads the mission registry every cycle and alerts (Chinese, scrubbed) when an active mission has made no progress for 15 minutes, re-alerting on its existing throttle cadence, silent again on recovery; dry-run still suppresses restarts only, never alerts, and no active mission means zero overhead. Hook: mission_tick joins the hook whitelist, emitted once per tick while a mission is active with only id/state/progress in the env and a discard-on-sanitize-failure rule - zero credential echo. Quiet hours and interval: mission.quiet_hours (empty or HH:MM-HH:MM, may cross midnight) lets only decision and final traffic through the window with a merge at the next open point, and mission.min_interval (0..86400, 0 = tier default) overrides the per-tier minimums; both validated with honest 400s. Mission constraints: start accepts an optional deadline (ISO 8601, must be in the future), redlines (<=500 chars) and deliverable (<=200 chars) - stored on the mission, injected into the plan and slice prompts, echoed on detail, absent = old clients unchanged; the plan preview still never waits for an answer. Console: the MISSIONS card grows a collapsible constraint block (datetime picker, live character counters), an approvals panel with a red paused-approve badge whose plan ids deep-link into the Web3 panel and highlight the matching card, quiet-hours and interval controls next to the tier selector, and red/amber badges for paused_approve and degraded; 20 new mission.* keys (packs 594 to 614). Verification: new tmp/e2e_mission_pause.py leg 73/73 - suspend/resume with the execute-refuses-without-approval assertion and zero order POSTs on the wire, heartbeat alert once then throttled then silent, quiet-window suppression with post-window merge, min_interval override, constraint validation plus prompt injection, mid-run restart resume from the registry, pause/resume 409 during paused_approve, mission_tick env capture, sentinel zero-leak and production byte identity.
